visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair, wearing a white button-down shirt and a grey textured tie, sits on a light-colored sofa. He holds a white rectangular iPhone box, gesturing enthusiastically while looking directly at the camera. The background features soft white curtains and warm indoor lighting, creating a bright studio-like domestic environment. Yellow text overlays appear at the top and bottom. (2) The man carefully slides the inner box out of the sleeve, revealing a white iPhone 16e. He holds the device up, rotating it to show the matte white glass back and the single circular camera lens in the upper corner. He points to the camera, his facial expression showing excitement and approval. The lighting remains bright and consistent. (3) The camera cuts to a close-up of the white iPhone 16e being compared side-by-side with an older iPhone SE and later a blue Android phone. The man's hands are visible manipulating the devices to show size differences and camera module heights. The setting shifts to a dark tabletop surface for these close-up comparisons. (4) Back to the man on the sofa, he holds the phone facing forward, revealing a large screen with a top notch. He pulls off a transparent plastic screen protector with a deliberate motion. His expression is slightly playful and teasing. The phone screen reflects the indoor lighting. He continues to gesture with his free hand while talking. (5) The video concludes with the man holding the phone with the screen on, displaying the iOS home screen. He points toward the camera and waves his hand, encouraging the viewer. He maintains a friendly and energetic facial expression. The background curtains are visible behind him as he speaks his final lines.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: iPhone 16e 全台首開!. [Subtitle]: 我們第一時間拿到了 iPhone 16e. (2) [Subtitle]: 應該是全台灣第一批. (3) [Subtitle]: 哎呀 這應該是 最漂亮的iPhone. (4) [Subtitle]: 因為只有一個鏡頭 超簡約的. (5) [Subtitle]: 跟iPhone SE相比 它的比例放大了. (6) [Subtitle]: 有一種夢回iPhone 4 的那種感覺. (7) [Subtitle]: 這麼簡約 我就是要搭一個 經典的蘋果白. (8) [Subtitle]: 在看發表時 我就覺得 它會是2025年 背面最簡約的. (9) [Subtitle]: 因為只有它 敢在2025年 2萬多塊的一個價錢 只給一個鏡頭. (10) [Subtitle]: 其實其它Android 都有兩個鏡頭以上. (11) [Subtitle]: 所以簡約真的是無敵啦. (12) [Subtitle]: 比標準版的 iPhone 16輕一點點 但整體手感應該跟 iPhone 16一樣. (13) [Subtitle]: 它這個鏡頭凸起也算短. (14) [Subtitle]: 所以它沒有翹翹板效應 所以它非常適合裸機拿. (15) [Subtitle]: 正面用的是 跟iPhone 13 iPhone 14標準版 一樣的螢幕 所以呢. (16) [Variety]: 尷尬.... (17) [Subtitle]: 夢回2021啊... 劉海螢幕 我就不吐槽了. (18) [Subtitle]: 同時我們長片的 實機開箱 也已經在YouTube上了 趕快去看吧.
